description: Manage Perl library dependencies using cpanminus.

parameters.name: executable
parameters.description: Override the path to the cpanm executable.

parameters.name: from_path
parameters.description: The local directory or tar.gz file to install from.

parameters.name: install_recommendations
parameters.description: If true, installs dependencies declared as recommends per META spec. If false, it ensures the dependencies declared as recommends are not installed, overriding any decision made earlier in PERL_CPANM_OPT. If parameter is not set, cpanm uses its existing defaults. When these dependencies fail to install, cpanm continues the installation, since they are just recommendation. Choices: false true

parameters.name: install_suggestions
parameters.description: If true, installs dependencies declared as suggests per META spec. If false, it ensures the dependencies declared as suggests are not installed, overriding any decision made earlier in PERL_CPANM_OPT. If parameter is not set, cpanm uses its existing defaults. When these dependencies fail to install, cpanm continues the installation, since they are just suggestions. Choices: false true

parameters.name: installdeps
parameters.description: Only install dependencies. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: locallib
parameters.description: Specify the install base to install modules.

parameters.name: mirror
parameters.description: Specifies the base URL for the CPAN mirror to use.

parameters.name: mirror_only
parameters.description: Use the mirror’s index file instead of the CPAN Meta DB. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Controls the module behavior. See notes below for more details. The default changed from compatibility to new in community.general 9.0.0. mode=new: The name parameter may refer to a module name, a distribution file, a HTTP URL or a git repository URL as described in cpanminus documentation. cpanm version specifiers are recognized. This is the default mode from community.general 9.0.0 onwards. mode=compatibility: This was the default mode before community.general 9.0.0. name must be either a module name or a distribution file. If the perl module given by name is installed (at the exact version when specified), then nothing happens. Otherwise, it is installed using the cpanm executable. name cannot be an URL, or a git URL. cpanm version specifiers do not work in this mode. ATTENTION: compatibility mode is deprecated and will be removed in community.general 13.0.0. Choices: "compatibility" "new" ← (default)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The Perl library to install. Valid values change according to the mode, see notes for more details. Note that for installing from a local path the parameter from_path should be used.

parameters.name: name_check
parameters.description: When mode=new, this parameter can be used to check if there is a module name installed (at version, when specified).

parameters.name: notest
parameters.description: Do not run unit tests. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version specification for the perl module. When mode=new, cpanm version operators are accepted.

examples:
- name: Install Dancer perl package
  community.general.cpanm:
    name: Dancer

- name: Install version 0.99_05 of the Plack perl package
  community.general.cpanm:
    name: MIYAGAWA/Plack-0.99_05.tar.gz

- name: Install Dancer into the specified locallib
  community.general.cpanm:
    name: Dancer
    locallib: /srv/webapps/my_app/extlib

- name: Install perl dependencies from local directory
  community.general.cpanm:
    from_path: /srv/webapps/my_app/src/

- name: Install Dancer perl package without running the unit tests in indicated locallib
  community.general.cpanm:
    name: Dancer
    notest: true
    locallib: /srv/webapps/my_app/extlib

- name: Install Dancer perl package from a specific mirror
  community.general.cpanm:
    name: Dancer
    mirror: 'http://cpan.cpantesters.org/'

- name: Install Dancer perl package into the system root path
  become: true
  community.general.cpanm:
    name: Dancer

- name: Install Dancer if it is not already installed OR the installed version is older than version 1.0
  community.general.cpanm:
    name: Dancer
    version: '1.0'

return_values.name: cpanm_version
return_values.description: Version of CPANMinus. Returned: always Sample: "1.7047"
